biggest_catch: The friend just has to open accounts - no deposit or transaction hoops stated on the page - but the page gives no fine print at all, so ask for terms before counting on it.
catches: Referring member and the friend each receive a $50 bonus once the friend's new accounts are open.
'Earn up to $500 a month!' - an unusually high monthly cap stated on the official page.
Described as an ongoing benefit ('now an ongoing benefit'), not a limited-time promotion.
No friend requirements beyond opening accounts are stated on the page; submit the referral form, the friend receives an email invitation and opens membership + accounts.
No fee to participate; local Maryland credit union (financial centers throughout Maryland).
Fine-print caveat: the official page shows no detailed terms and conditions - eligibility, timing, and tax treatment are not stated on the page.
